author: iWst
content: GPU bug fix: switched all DataTextures from FloatType → HalfFloatType. Most GPUs silently fall back to NEAREST sampling on FloatType textures because OES_texture_float_linear isn't always enabled — this was making the browser show hex cell-frequency content while my offline render (which always uses bilinear) showed smooth procedural surface. HalfFloatType has universal linear-filter support. Browser should now match offline iter11-sphere appearance.
